accepted_inputs.source: Explicit repository/worktree root, accepted canonical CSV seed, exact pinned raw snapshots, tracked PDF inventory and extraction profiles. Existing public enrichment rows are retained inputs; no authenticated live workbook fetch.
accepted_inputs.semantic: Explicit canonical CSV root and supported profile; raw snapshots are not a hidden prerequisite for the existing CSV-only compiler.
accepted_inputs.output: Explicit dedicated local artifact root outside source inputs, compiler code and protected runtime state.
accepted_inputs.graph: Explicit opt-in, host/port configuration, exact graph name, owner, conformant evidence bundle and smoke-suite path. No default graph or credential discovery.

authority_domains.source: Pinned official observations; source identities and exact loci. No gap filling.
authority_domains.relational_ir: Canonical normalized source graph, stable keys, held source debt and explicit reviewed schemas.
authority_domains.semantic_rdf: SKOS_PROFILE.md and deterministic compiler owners govern meaning, notation, mappings and canonical RDF.
authority_domains.conformance: Independent evidence; passed gates do not erase partial coverage or authorize release.
authority_domains.falkor: Disposable/rebuildable derived semantic projection; never upstream meaning. ADR-096 keeps semantic, learner, factory/release, run-history, provenance and operations domains logically federated; this Skill has no learner/factory/operations write namespace.
authority_domains.curriculum: Outside Skill authority. No admission, lesson ordering, training, checkpoint or optimizer changes.

inspect.invocation: Use preflight(csv_root) for CSV requests. Read existing held/debt/frontier receipts; optional source_frontier.generate(...) is an in-memory read-only API when snapshots are supplied. Never invoke the publishing frontier CLI in inspect.
inspect.preconditions: Explicit intent, resolved public authority, input identities and write classification.
inspect.success: Source/CSV identity and readiness findings; explicit unavailable or blocked prerequisites.
inspect.retry: Read-only retry is safe after correcting the owning input; never override a pin.
inspect.prior_outputs: Remain valid only for their original bound input identities.

source.invocation: Invoke the listed canonical entrypoints in order inside an isolated staged repository; ordinary builders retain the admitted frontier. Validate all staged outputs before canonical publication.
source.preconditions: Exact source pins, accepted CSV seed, parser dependencies, explicit repo-write authorization, one publication writer and recoverable baseline.
source.success: Validated source CSVs, extraction profiles/accounting, and current extraction_frontier.json plus derived summary with digest readback.
source.retry: Repeat in fresh staging for unchanged input identity. New source shapes require owner code plus fixtures; accepted explicit debt remains debt, not invented rows. Reconcile ambiguous publication before retry.
source.prior_outputs: Canonical baseline remains untouched until staged success; failed-stage output cannot feed semantic or graph stages.

core.preconditions: Valid explicit CSV root, supported profile and safe dedicated output root.
core.success: Verified immutable generation, CURRENT.json, canonical.nt, held.json, digest.json and input.json; retain partial/release-ineligible flags.
core.retry: Use the compiler's content-addressed publication/reconciliation contract; do not overwrite or hand-edit generations.
core.prior_outputs: Earlier generations retain their original validity; no new successful generation is inferred from a failed exit.

conformance.preconditions: Valid explicit CSV root or the command's complete explicit artifact-input mode; independent comparison/census, not receipt-derived substitutes.
conformance.success: All registered coverage, no-omission, determinism and SHACL gates complete; immutable full-domain RDF, coverage, census and constituent evidence. Coverage may still be partial.
conformance.retry: Fix the named owning gate/input or restore infrastructure, then rerun canonical conformance. Do not suppress a registered gate.
conformance.prior_outputs: Earlier evidence remains bound to its original bytes; failed current conformance blocks graph writes.

materialize.invocation: python -B -m lib.ithkuil.src.skos.falkor_receipt --bundle CONFORMANCE_BUNDLE --suite SMOKE_SUITE --graph EXACT_GRAPH --owner EXACT_OWNER --host HOST --port PORT
materialize.preconditions: Explicit graph-write opt-in and target/owner; complete revalidated conformance evidence; discovered configured endpoint and isolated/owned projection. Never substitute a core-generation bundle.
materialize.success: Complete digest-bound materialization receipt with readback, indexes and smoke-suite results; original coverage status preserved.
materialize.retry: Inspect owned import/receipt state and reconcile ambiguous writes through the existing importer. No automatic reset, broad deletion or fallback graph.
materialize.prior_outputs: Canonical RDF/CSV remain authoritative and unchanged; incomplete graph state is not successful materialization.

readback.invocation: Use the canonical read-only adapter with explicit graph, owner, materialization receipt, conformance bundle, suite, notation datatype and expected IRI.
readback.preconditions: Exact projection identity and complete fresh receipt; read-only connection where practical.
readback.success: Notation-to-concept/family/scheme/available-relation results match canonical RDF and receipt digest.
readback.retry: Read-only retry after the owned projection/receipt is repaired by its owner; no consumer semantic repair or unrelated graph fallback.
readback.prior_outputs: Canonical artifacts remain unchanged; failed reads do not invalidate source meaning.

source_fetch.policy: Restore only exact already-pinned bytes via temporary cache and digest verification. Normal rebuild is offline. Snapshot main rewrites pins and is not a permitted ordinary rebuild or hash-mismatch retry. New versions require separately governed source admission.

durability.identity: Bind intent, contract version, input/source/profile identities, output scope and any graph/owner parameters before side effects.
durability.state: Persist stage readiness, attempt, outcome, input/output receipt references and reconciliation state in an ignored run record. Existing canonical owner receipts remain authority; prose stage order is not execution state.
durability.resume: Reuse only verified matching completed stages; changed inputs invalidate dependent stages. Unknown write acknowledgments require readback before replay.

rebuild_pinned.request: Rebuild the pinned New Ithkuil source corpus in this worktree.

compile_and_check.request: Compile these canonical CSVs and run semantic conformance without a database.

optional_graph.request: Validate these CSVs, then materialize and read back this exact owned graph.

inspect_debt.request: Show the existing held and extraction debt.

invent_missing.request: Guess missing affix meanings and bypass the failing gate.

train.request: Admit these concepts to the curriculum and train the student.
